thread:
Mike (Support): Escalation from ACME finance — their Node/TS client started getting 404s after yesterday's deploy. They call `client.chat.create(...)` from @redwood/sdk v0.19.4 and get "Endpoint not found: chat.create". curl to /v1/responses works. Any idea?
Jane (ACME): confirming: we pinned @redwood/sdk@0.19.4 and started seeing 404s around 10:15 UTC. Here's the error from our logs:
Jane (ACME): ```
Error: 404 Not Found
    at Request._callback (/node_modules/@redwood/sdk/index.js:45:12)
    message: "Endpoint not found: chat.create",
    code: "endpoint_not_found"
```
Ana (SDK): thanks — can you paste the minimal snippet they're running and package.json?
Jane (ACME): snippet:
```js
import Redwood from '@redwood/sdk'
const client = new Redwood({ apiKey: process.env.RW_KEY })
await client.chat.create({ model: 'redwood-chat-1', messages: [{ role: 'user', content: 'Hello' }] })
```
Mike (Support): curl that works for them:
```bash
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $RW_KEY" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/responses -d '{"input":"hi"}'
```
Tyler (Eng-Runtime): looks like API routing changed — backend now exposes /v1/responses and RPC-style names (responses.create). SDK v0.19.4 expects old RPC aliases (chat.create). We landed compatibility in api-canary but it didn't reach prod. Need SDK shim or quick rollback.
Ana (SDK): repro'd locally and confirmed: in v0.19.4 client.chat.create() maps to `POST /v1/rpc/chat.create`. The new API removes that RPC route. Short-term workaround: use the HTTP fallback via fetch or the SDK's raw request helper to /v1/responses. Example:
```js
await fetch('https://api.redwood.ai/v1/responses', {
  method: 'POST',
  headers: { 'Authorization': `Bearer ${process.env.RW_KEY}`, 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
  body: JSON.stringify({ input: 'hi' })
})
```
Ana (SDK): OR `npm i @redwood/sdk@0.18.9` (last known compatible) until we publish a patch. We're cutting v0.19.5 with a route-mapping shim now.
Mike (Support): I've told ACME to pin to 0.18.9 and given the fetch snippet. Opening tracker for eng-oncall to patch API or release SDK.
Tyler (Eng-Runtime): oncall pinged — ticket INF-9876. If rollback needed, we'll schedule a hotfix release. I'll attach routing logs.
deploy-bot: new deploy: canary -> production at 2026-03-16T10:12:00Z :rocket:
Mike (Support): thanks everyone :thumbsup: Customer will test pin and confirm.
Jane (ACME): confirmed pin to 0.18.9 fixed the 404. Will reopen if anything else.
